Vereisten:
houder zijn van een diploma dat toegang geeft tot niveau B en van een diploma van een opleiding ruimtelijke ordening zoals bepaald in het ministerieel besluit van 13 juli 2000; de kandidaten moeten slagen in een, door de gemeente ingericht, aanwervingsexamen, een gunstige beoordeling bekomen na een assessment inzake leidinggeven, grondige kennis van het decreet van 18 mei 1999 houdende de organisatie van de ruimtelijke ordening en latere wijzigingen en de uitvoerings-besluiten, basiskennis van de gemeentewetgeving, onafhankelijkheid tegenover externe beïnvloeding, kunnen werken onder tijdsdruk, flexi-biliteit, klantvriendelijkheid. Is recruiting:
A second lieutenant in the professional staff of the fire service (PBA 1). Job description:
Under the authority of the head of service, he/she shares responsibility for the management of the fire brigade. Under the direction of the head of service, he/she is jointly responsible for the organisation, coordination, planning and proper functioning of the service in accordance with the legal provisions in this regard. The second lieutenant may be promoted to the rank of lieutenant if he/she meets all the conditions set out in the royal decree of 19 April 1999 and following. Admission and recruitment conditions:
1. To have conduct consistent with the requirements of the position sought. 2. To enjoy civil and political rights. 3. To comply with the military service laws (for male candidates). 4. To be physically fit. 5. To possess Belgian nationality. 6. To be at least 1.60 m tall for male candidates and 1.55 m for female candidates. 7. Diploma:
Required diploma as stated in the annex to the royal decree of 19 April 1999 and following establishing the aptitude and competence criteria as well as the appointment and promotion conditions for officers of public fire services. To be in possession of the certificates as determined in the royal decree of 19 April 1999 and following, or to obtain these diplomas/certificates during the probationary period. 8. To hold a CE driving licence or to obtain it during the probationary period. 9. Age: minimum 21 years on the date of 15 March 2003. 10. Resident in the municipality of Duffel, no later than 6 months after the date of permanent appointment. 11. To pass a recruitment examination. Your applications with the addition of a detailed curriculum vitae, as well as copies of the required diplomas and certificates, must be addressed by registered letter or against acknowledgement of receipt, to the College of Mayor and Aldermen, Gemeentestraat 21, 2570 Duffel, no later than 15 March 2003. The complete job description and profile and the examination programme can be obtained at the town hall, personnel department (tel. 015-30 72 43/47/49) or e-mail: rudi.gillis@publilink.be)

1 FT nurse C3 (certificated) 1 FT nurse BV1 (graduate) 1 FT assistant cook D1
in contractual capacity (for indefinite duration): 1 FT elderly care assistant C1
Job description nurses:
care and nursing of the elderly; monitoring the general nutritional status of residents; social support of the elderly; guiding and supporting elderly care assistants in their tasks; administrative and logistical tasks. Job description elderly care assistant:
care of the elderly; support in the nursing of the elderly; assistance with meals for the elderly; social support of the elderly; administrative and logistical tasks. Job description assistant cook:
preparing and serving meals; storing deliveries, foodstuffs and leftovers; maintaining the kitchen; coordinating the organisation of the kitchen in the absence of the head cook; supporting tasks. Special recruitment conditions:
nurse C3: to hold a diploma of certificated nurse; nurse BV1: to hold a diploma of higher education of the short type, graduate nursing; elderly care assistant C1: to hold a diploma, certificate or certificate of HSBO family or elderly care, or equivalent; assistant cook D1: to hold a diploma of lower secondary education or equivalent. Recruitment examinations will be organised and recruitment reserves of 3 years established. Main general admission and recruitment conditions: To be Belgian or a national of an EU member state. To have good moral character and be physically fit. To comply with the military service laws (for male candidates). To be 18 years old on 7 March 2003. We offer:
A good salary. Financial valorisation of private seniority for nurses and elderly care assistant. Meal vouchers. Free hospitalisation insurance. Contribution to transport costs when using public transport for home-work travel. Bicycle allowance. Extensive training opportunities. How to apply:
Send your application no later than 7 March 2003 (postmark date) to the P.C.S.W. Machelen,  
C. Peetersstraat 45, 1830 Machelen, with the accompanying supporting documents:
a curriculum vitae; proof of good moral character (max. 3 months old); an extract from the birth certificate; a copy of the required educational certificate; a family composition (to be obtained from the population service of the municipality); a military certificate (for male candidates). context:
25, wonende te 9300 Aalst, Graanmarkt 11, handelend als gevolmachtigde van Mevr. Aelbrecht, Martine Anitta, geboren te Meldert op 21 april 1957, handelend in de hoedanigheid van moeder over de nog bij haar inwonende minderjarige zijnde:
Van Nieuwenborg, Nathalie, geboren te Aalst op 25 oktober 1987.
text:
De comparant verklaart ons, handelend in zijn gezegde hoedanig-
heid, onder voorrecht van boedelbeschrijving de nalatenschap te
aanvaarden van wijlen Van Nieuwenborg, François Jean, geboren te Asse op 5 augustus 1952, in leven laatst wonende te 9310 Meldert (O.-Vl.), Parijsstraat 67/2, en overleden te Aalst op 11 mei 1997. Tot staving van zijn verklaring heeft de comparant ons een onder-handse volmacht overhandigd. Tot staving van zijn verklaring heeft de comparant ons een afschrift vertoond van de beschikking van de vrederechter van het tweede kanton Aalst d.d. 13 december 2002, waarbij Mevr. Aelbrecht, Martine Anitta, gemachtigd werd om in naam van de voornoemde minderjarige de nalatenschap van wijlen Van Nieuwenborg, François Jean, te aanvaarden onder voorrecht van boedelbeschrijving. Hij heeft ons tevens verklaard om in deze procedure, en bij toepas-sing van artikel 793 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek, woonplaats te kiezen ter studie van Mr. notaris Breckpot, Danièle, ter standplaats 9300 Aalst, Graanmarkt 11, alwaar de schuldeisers en legatarissen zich bekend dienen te maken. Waarvan akte, welke de comparant, na gedane lezing, met ons, adjunct-griffier, heeft ondertekend. (Get.) P. Breckpot; V. Durinck. (3220)
